Fix class inheritance detection in implicit scripting codepaths

Replace __torch_script_class__ attribute check with _get_script_class() registry lookup to properly detect inheritance in try_ann_to_type. This ensures that when a class B inherits from class A, the scripting system correctly recognizes A as already compiled rather than treating it as a new class.

Changes:
- Remove cls.__torch_script_class__ = True assignment in _add_script_class
- Update try_ann_to_type to use _get_script_class(qualified_name) for both Enum and regular class checks
- Add _script_classes.clear() to clear_class_registry() for proper test isolation
- Add test_class_inheritance_implicit test case to verify the fix
messages.minimax:

Remove __torch_script_class__ class attribute marking and instead query the _script_classes registry via _get_script_class() to determine if a class is a registered script class. This improves class inheritance detection in implicit scripting codepaths like try_ann_to_type. Also clear _script_classes registry in clear_class_registry() to properly reset state in tests.
messages.claude:
jit: replace __torch_script_class__ attribute with registry lookup

Use _get_script_class from jit._state to check if a class has been scripted instead of relying on the __torch_script_class__ attribute. This fixes inheritance detection in implicit scripting codepaths (e.g. try_ann_to_type), where subclasses were not recognized because the attribute was only set on the explicitly compiled class. Also clear _script_classes in clear_class_registry to avoid stale state between tests.

pr_title: [Release/1.9] Link whole CuDNN for CUDA-11.1

messages.kimi:
Add USE_WHOLE_CUDNN option for CUDA 11.1 to include fp16 fast kernels

This change introduces a new CMake option `USE_WHOLE_CUDNN` that enables whole-library linking for cuDNN when building for CUDA 11.1 on Linux. This is needed to include fp16 fast kernels that would otherwise be excluded by the linker.

Key changes:
- Add USE_WHOLE_CUDNN CMake option dependent on USE_STATIC_CUDNN
- Split caffe2::cudnn into caffe2::cudnn-public and caffe2::cudnn-private interfaces
- Enable whole-archive linking for cuDNN when USE_WHOLE_CUDNN is ON
- Add cublas dependency to cudnn-private interface
- Update binary_populate_env.sh to set USE_WHOLE_CUDNN=ON for cu111 builds
- Fix USE_GLOO_WITH_OPENSSL quoting consistency
messages.minimax:

messages.claude:
Split cuDNN into public/private interface targets to enable static linking with whole-archive option

Introduce separate caffe2::cudnn-public and caffe2::cudnn-private interface targets so that headers and link instructions can be propagated independently. The private target carries the actual link line, allowing whole-library linking via USE_WHOLE_CUDNN (enabled for cu111 on Linux to pull in fp16 fast kernels) and an explicit dependency on caffe2::cublas. Update consumers (torch_cuda, torch_cuda_cpp) to link the private target, and adjust the CI env script and Summary output accordingly. Also normalize USE_GLOO_WITH_OPENSSL to "ON" and move the caffe2::cublas definition ahead of the cudnn block.

messages.kimi:
Add Default BlasBackend with heuristics for ROCm Instinct GPUs

This commit introduces a new `Default` value to the `BlasBackend` enum that automatically selects the optimal BLAS backend based on the GPU architecture. For ROCm, AMD Instinct GPUs (gfx90a, gfx942, gfx950) now default to hipBLASLt, while other architectures continue to use hipBLAS. The change also unifies the environment variable handling for CUDA and ROCm, allowing both `TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_CUBLASLT` and `TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT` to work on either platform.
messages.minimax:
Add Default BlasBackend with ROCm architecture-aware heuristics

Introduce a new `BlasBackend::Default` enum value that defers the actual backend selection to runtime heuristics, replacing compile-time `#ifdef USE_ROCM` branching. On ROCm, the default now automatically selects hipBLASLt for Instinct architectures (gfx90a, gfx942, gfx950) and cuBLAS for others. Add "default" and "hipblas" as valid input aliases for the preferred_blas_library API. Deprecate the TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT environment variable in favor of the new TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_CUBLASLT flag.
messages.claude:
Introduce Default value for BlasBackend and resolve it lazily on first access

Add a Default entry to the BlasBackend enum, exposed via torch._C._BlasBackend and accepted by torch.backends.cuda.preferred_blas_library as "default". The blas_preferred_backend member now initializes to Default instead of Cublas, and blasPreferredBackend() resolves it on first call: Cublas by default, Cublaslt on AMD Instinct targets (gfx90a/gfx942/gfx950) under ROCm. Environment variables TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_CUBLASLT and TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT are both honored as aliases regardless of build target. Also add "hipblas" as an alias for "cublas" in the Python mapping, replace getNumGPUs() with detail::getCUDAHooks().deviceCount() in the ROCm arch checks, and add a test covering default resolution, accepted/invalid inputs, and env var overrides.

- Replace PTX instructions with equivalent AMDGCN instructions (e.g., `mov.f32` → `v_mov_b32`, `add.f32` → `v_add_f32`)
- Update constraint strings from PTX format (e.g., `=f,f`) to AMDGCN format (e.g., `=v,v`)
- Handle AMDGCN multi-line assembly using newlines instead of PTX semicolons
- Add proper escaping for newlines in AMDGCN asm strings when generating Triton wrapper code
- Add gfx950+ requirement for native bf16 conversion instructions
- Fix metadata output formatting to handle newlines in AMDGCN asm strings
- Remove `test_inline_asm_elementwise` from CUDA-only skip list in run_test.py
- Update `simple_inline_asm` sample function to use AMDGCN instructions when running on HIP
messages.claude:
Support ROCm/HIP in inline_asm_elementwise tests and codegen

- Add AMDGCN asm variants (v_mov_b32, v_add_f32, etc.) gated on torch.version.hip alongside existing PTX, using "v" constraints in place of "f"/"h"/"r".
- Update Inductor triton codegen to emit HIP asm/constraints via repr() with doubled backslashes so newlines survive both the wrapper cache and Triton kernel string layers.
- Handle AMDGCN asm containing newlines in stringfy_layout by splitting format_node output across comment-prefixed lines.
- Add HIP skip conditions for pre-gfx950 in add_bf16_native tests via evaluate_gfx_arch_within, and gate the SM capability skip on non-HIP.
- Re-enable the higher_order_ops/test_inline_asm_elementwise test target by removing it from the skip list in test/run_test.py.

pr_title: [MPS] Fix SDPA wrong output for permuted q/k/v with B > 1

messages.kimi:
Fix MPS SDPA kernel to handle non-contiguous batch strides

Add qkv_batch_strides_heads parameter to sdpa_vector and sdpa_vector_2pass_1 kernels to properly compute batch and head indices from thread position. This fixes incorrect results when inputs have permuted dimensions (e.g., from .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)).

Also relax the contiguity check to only require stride(-1) == 1 instead of full contiguity, avoiding unnecessary copies for common layout transformations.

Fixes #181133
messages.minimax:
[MPS] 修复 Attention kernel 处理 batch stride 的问题

添加 qkv_batch_strides_heads 参数以正确传递 batch 维度的 stride 信息，使 Attention kernel 能正确处理非连续或经过 permute 操作的输入张量。添加对应的回归测试用例验证修复效果。
messages.claude:
Support non-contiguous batch strides in MPS SDPA vector kernels

Adds batch stride parameters to the sdpa_vector and sdpa_vector_2pass_1
Metal kernels so that Q/K/V tensors with arbitrary batch strides (e.g.
permuted inputs like [B, S, H, D] -> [B, H, S, D]) are indexed
correctly instead of requiring contiguous memory. The threadgroup id
now encodes both batch and head (bh_idx), which is decomposed into
batch_idx and head_idx via the passed-in num_heads.

Replaces the restrictive is_contiguous_or_head_seq_transposed check
with a looser can_use_kernel_strides predicate that only requires the
innermost head-dim stride to be 1, since the kernels now handle
arbitrary outer strides via the explicit stride arguments.

Adds a regression test (test_fast_vector_permuted_inputs_regression)
covering permuted inputs that previously produced wrong results.

Fixes #181133.
